$ stk doctor --probe
exit 1
--- stdout

  probing the brokered path with a local stand-in for probe.supertoolkit.invalid
  the host is in .invalid and can never resolve, so a DNS failure proves a bypass

  ✓ curl               honoured    the provider received the substituted credential
  ! python3 urllib     bypassed    it resolved the host itself, so it never asked the broker
  ✗ node fetch         refused-ca  it would not trust the broker's certificate — fails loudly, so safe
  – go net/http        missing     no toolchain here

  the broker saw 0 request(s) and substituted 0 credential(s)

  ! a client reached past the broker. This is the one failure mode that is silent:
  such a client sends the placeholder to the provider and gets a plausible 401,
  which looks like a credential problem rather than a routing one.
  Do not broker that client. See docs/limitations.md.
--- stderr
stk: probe: a client bypassed the broker

$ stk doctor --probe --with-proxy-key
exit 1
--- stdout

  probing the brokered path with a local stand-in for probe.supertoolkit.invalid
  the host is in .invalid and can never resolve, so a DNS failure proves a bypass
  the broker under probe requires a proxy key, sent in the proxy URL

  ✓ curl               honoured    the provider received the substituted credential
  ! python3 urllib     bypassed    it resolved the host itself, so it never asked the broker
  ✗ node fetch         refused-ca  it would not trust the broker's certificate — fails loudly, so safe
  – go net/http        missing     no toolchain here

  the broker saw 0 request(s) and substituted 0 credential(s)

  ! a client reached past the broker. This is the one failure mode that is silent:
  such a client sends the placeholder to the provider and gets a plausible 401,
  which looks like a credential problem rather than a routing one.
  Do not broker that client. See docs/limitations.md.
--- stderr
stk: probe: a client bypassed the broker


$ stk doctor --probe
exit 0
--- stdout

  probing the brokered path with a local stand-in for probe.supertoolkit.invalid
  the host is in .invalid and can never resolve, so a DNS failure proves a bypass

  ✓ curl               honoured    the provider received the substituted credential
  ✓ python3 urllib     honoured    the provider received the substituted credential
  ✓ node fetch         honoured    the provider received the substituted credential
  – go net/http        missing     no toolchain here

  the broker saw 0 request(s) and substituted 0 credential(s)

  every client present here goes through the broker.
--- stderr


$ stk doctor --probe --with-proxy-key --json
exit 1
--- stdout
[
  {
    "client": "curl",
    "outcome": "failed",
    "detail": "proxy credential not honoured"
  },
  {
    "client": "python3 urllib",
    "outcome": "honoured",
    "detail": "the provider received the substituted credential"
  },
  {
    "client": "node fetch",
    "outcome": "honoured",
    "detail": "the provider received the substituted credential"
  },
  {
    "client": "go net/http",
    "outcome": "missing",
    "detail": "no toolchain here"
  }
]
--- stderr

  probing the brokered path with a local stand-in for probe.supertoolkit.invalid
  the host is in .invalid and can never resolve, so a DNS failure proves a bypass
  the broker under probe requires a proxy key, sent in the proxy URL

  ✗ curl               failed      proxy credential not honoured
  ✓ python3 urllib     honoured    the provider received the substituted credential
  ✓ node fetch         honoured    the provider received the substituted credential
  – go net/http        missing     no toolchain here

  the broker saw 0 request(s) and substituted 0 credential(s)

  a client failed in a way that is neither a bypass nor a CA refusal; see the detail above.
stk: probe: a client failed


$ stk doctor --probe
exit 1
--- stdout

  probing the brokered path with a local stand-in for probe.supertoolkit.invalid
  the host is in .invalid and can never resolve, so a DNS failure proves a bypass

  – curl               missing     not installed here
  – python3 urllib     missing     not installed here
  – node fetch         missing     not installed here
  – go net/http        missing     no toolchain here

  the broker saw 0 request(s) and substituted 0 credential(s)

  no client was exercised; nothing is proven.
--- stderr
stk: no client was exercised; nothing is proven
